Later matching geometry cannot replace missing call acknowledgement; completed movement, save and readback facts remain separate. Target deltas require 0.0001 mm representability. Only selected text inventory envelopes compare by independently rounding predicted and observed extrema to four decimal millimetres, matching the existing model precision. Raw before/after extrema and stroke-array witnesses remain in receipts and must independently reproduce their observed envelopes/strokes. Positions, formats, identity, strokes at existing reader precision, all non-target fields including raw witnesses and complete physical geometry remain exact. Missing reads, extra changes, ambiguous replies or failed protection stop dependent persistence without replaying Go. Supported contact uses observed filled circle/closed straight polygon material, complete cutouts and round drilled holes; bbox-only, negative pads, unsupported contours and missing readback remain incomplete. Anchors are actual selected pin centers or old trace first/last vertices; interior taps and intermediate vertices are unsupported. Input coordinates and width must already lie on the four-decimal-mm grid; nothing is rounded. Selected pin-owned round terminal holes require native subtraction and positive continuous annulus contact; foreign holes, cutouts and hole-only contact refuse. Query and origin files retain original bytes/path/SHA; snapshot ID, actual net UID/layer, component/node membership and complete current protection must rebind before dispatch. Missing or unsupported candidate endpoint contact, foreign-material separation or readable named minimum-width diagnostics refuse before insertion; a known below-minimum width is not made eligible by native post-checking. Native plans also sample each declared vertex's location scheme and its target net class's named minimum, typical and expansion widths in explicit mm; an unreadable point sample or an observed lower-than-minimum request refuses. Segments, clearance influence areas and child-rule precedence remain unverified, and sampling does not grant eligibility. Master observations never become full effective-rule applicability. Source genesis derives from a complete public closed-copy operation, authenticated in the original continuous journal and independently fully read back; only declared public PRJ library references may relocate. An external prep script or supplied receipt cannot grant writing. Later connections require a complete verifiable prior saved receipt from the original SDK and its exact same-Close recovery ZIP. Non-no-op requests require a new --recovery-backup outside all project/input trees. After Close=True and empty ActiveDocument, read every closed member including actual icdb bytes, exclusively create and verify that ZIP, then Open and verify material. The frozen closed_snapshot_sampling contract permits at most 17 complete read-only two-pass closed-tree observations, with 500ms only between attempts (at most 8 seconds of inter-attempt waiting; file hashing is additional). Every attempt rechecks the same application generation and empty ActiveDocument; identity drift stops immediately. Retain each exact error, elapsed time and final tree fingerprint. This does not guarantee native file-handle release. This bound applies to stabilization; archive sealing and verification retain their additional complete checks. No Save, Close, Open or copper insertion is replayed during file stabilization. A later backup that saves again is not an interchangeable continuation source. Same-component choices are a no-op without mutation eligibility or apply/Save. Native TransactionStart(1), one PutTrace(...,None,0,4), TransactionEnd(True) use formal 151.0 modified-data DRC; strict BOOL=True is supplementary to exact new-trace material, two-group merge, native topology accounting and all old/foreign-object protection. The PutTrace returned UID is a pre-End observation, not a persistent identity promise. The final new UID comes from full independent differences; every old raw UID, path, width, layer and net must remain exact. Only the existing primary descriptor and the two exact, existing and pinned Layout/LayoutDB.lyt and Work/Layout_Temp/LayoutDB.lyt stores may be declared transaction copper-storage outputs; no directory wildcard or new output file. Save/Close have separately bound exact-existing Layout/Temp storage, current-user UserSettings, strictly delimited HKP view fields and existing global Global_Constants.WindowPlacement numeric fields, bounded BMP thumbnail/save log and the unique icdb closed-visibility transition. Five exact session-marker paths require authenticated absence in the current closed-source ZIP: Save preserves them, Close may naturally remove them, and Open may recreate bounded markers only from closed absence; two temporary reports must remain empty. An existing nonempty ForwardAnnotation.txt authenticated in that closed source is instead listed in protected_source_reports: a strict protected input in every phase, never an allowed output or removable marker. Its live bytes must equal source; rewrite, deletion, substitution or missing provenance refuses. This exception does not grant other paths any marker permission. The native auto-save log retains historical source bytes separately: initial live bytes must equal source or be exactly empty; Save/continuation preserve actual live bytes, Close only appends validated actual-board blocks, and Open may retain the closed log or reset it to exactly empty. Other rewrites refuse. No lock or marker is deleted by the tool. At Open only, six existing backups may copy their exact declared closed-source bytes: main Graphics Settings.bak from main HKP, UserSettings.bak from actual current-user UPF, three Work/BackupDatabase stores from their matching Layout stores, and Work/JobPrefsDB.bak from Layout JobPrefsDB.jpf. Every source must remain unchanged after Open. PCBLogFile may remain closed-unchanged or restore its exact initial frozen live text; retain the full closed Save log. These are byte-copy/reset proofs, not private DB semantics; other Work/Config changes refuse. Every other file remains protected. server journals remain separately inventoried under the disclosed exclusion policy. Locked live icdb bytes remain unknown/source-only until the distinct closed read. Opaque storage changes do not establish complete private rule/cache semantics. Undeclared working or rule-file changes stop persistence; names do not make them harmless. Save/Close require actual BOOL=True, observed empty document and exact authenticated reopen with complete material/protection equality. Failure retains stages, reply/UID facts and unknown outcomes without automatic rollback, extra Save, cleanup or native write replay. The contract and synthetic controls do not establish a passed native write, full effective-rule parser, production routing or manufacturing.
